blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan— Police arrested a 59-year-old gunsmith and seized 36.10 grams of suspected shabu worth P245,480 during a search operation in this town on Wednesday in Pozorrubio. The suspect was classified as a high-value individual (HVI) in the police operation. The police teams implemented Search Warrant No. U-2026-032, which resulted in the seizure of three heat-sealed transparent plastic sachets containing the suspected shabu. READ: P1.06-M ‘shabu’ seized in Pangasinan Also seized were a black-and-yellow lighter and a gray coin purse allegedly used as a container for the drug evidence.
